scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,worker --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@waspada/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@waspada/worker"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tools/evaluation/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/ai/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/local-pipeline/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/accounts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && tsx --test tools/evaluation/casebook.test.ts tools/evaluation/casebook-cli.test.ts tools/ai/ninerouter-smoke.test.ts tools/ai/ninerouter-cli.test.ts tools/ai/extraction-probe.test.ts && npm run pipeline:test && npm run accounts:test
scripts.dev:pipeline: concurrently --kill-others --names web,worker,pipeline,intelligence --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=@waspada/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@waspada/worker" "npm run pipeline:serve -- --enable --watch --state app-demo --interval-ms 5000 --max-polls 60" "npm run intelligence:dev"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run build:worker
